manifest_provenance: Built by calling VDA's own benchmark/dataset_extract/eval_utils.py::gen_json directly (unmodified) against the raw Bonn-RGBD scenes at /mnt/DATA/DegradedDepth/data/TEST/bonn (26 rgbd_bonn_* scenes, all already 640x480 even-dimensioned so dataset_extract_bonn.py's own even_or_odd crop is a no-op) -- no file copying needed. start_id=30,end_id=140 (110 frames/scene), matching the extraction script's own 'like DepthCrafter' comment for bonn_video.json.
comparability_caveat: This measurement uses ALL 26 Bonn-RGBD scenes present on crispwork. The paper states it used only 10 scenes from Bonn (Table 1's population); dataset_extract_bonn.py's own code does not filter by scene name (unlike NYUv2's 8 explicitly-named scenes), so the specific 10-scene subset the paper's reported number reflects is not recoverable from the code. This result numerically beats the paper's VDA-S (Ours) Bonn figure (0.083/0.950) -- NOT evidence of outperforming the paper; different population, not a fair comparison. Do not quote these two numbers side by side.
